name: Company onboarding
steps: Owner creates organization -> validates website or files -> optionally connects providers -> approves Company Brain profile -> assigns AI team -> configures authority -> creates first mission.
contracts: Organization identity, source provenance, plan approvals, no unauthorized connector access.

name: Cross-department campaign
steps: Chief of Staff researches commerce/finance -> Marketing and Creative produce plan/assets -> Finance checks margin -> owner approves -> tools publish -> receipts verify -> Insights reports.
contracts: Spend reservation, publishing scopes, consent, asset rights, provider confirmation, rollback limitations.

name: Revenue decline investigation
steps: Owner asks -> Finance reconciles actuals -> Commerce/Marketing/Sales compare drivers -> report separates fact/hypothesis -> plan with assumptions -> explicit change approvals.
contracts: Source freshness, double-count prevention, attribution uncertainty.

name: Customer request to resolution
steps: Request enters Service -> contact verified -> AI answers from approved KB or escalates -> order/booking/finance updates if authorized -> customer notified -> case closed with evidence.
contracts: Identity, privacy, service SLA and no double-refund.

name: Sales-to-cash
steps: Lead -> CRM qualify -> proposal -> quote approval -> customer acceptance -> project/order -> invoice -> bank reconciliation -> reporting.
contracts: Canonical customer ID, accepted price version, financial posting and audit.

name: Hire-to-onboard
steps: HR opens position -> candidate reviews -> approved offer -> employee record -> IT access request -> training/calendar -> payroll inputs -> manager signoff.
contracts: Applicant retention, discrimination safeguards, identity and payroll approvals.

name: Design-to-publish
steps: Creative brief -> Brand Intelligence -> editable Studio file -> human+AI reviews -> responsive/accessibility QA -> approved publish -> versioned live output.
contracts: Editable structure, brand rules, asset licensing, provider confirmation.

name: Build-to-deploy
steps: App brief -> data/roles architecture -> visual+code builder -> sandbox tests -> security/UX QA -> stage -> production approval -> monitor -> rollback if warranted.
contracts: Environment isolation, no secret exposure, release gates.

name: Document-to-knowledge
steps: Upload -> antivirus/validation -> extract -> classify -> canonical mapping -> discrepancy review -> approve fact -> scoped retrieval -> retention and correction.
contracts: Prompt injection, GDPR/retention, source-to-fact traceability.

name: Booking-to-service
steps: Customer selects service -> real inventory/staff available -> reserve slot -> payment/deposit -> confirm -> reminders -> check-in -> completion -> invoice/service history.
contracts: Atomic slot holds, timezone, cancellation policy and receipts.

name: Replenishment-to-payment
steps: Stock threshold -> forecast -> requisition -> policy approval -> PO -> supplier acknowledgment -> receipt/scan -> AP bill -> payment authorization -> reconciliation.
contracts: Supplier identity, physical evidence, ledger consistency, spend cap.

name: Connector incident recovery
steps: Health warning -> dedupe incident -> classify provider/internal -> safe retry or repair -> owner reconnect if required -> authoritative verification -> resume queued missions.
contracts: Unknown side effects, no privilege escalation, auditable resolution.

name: AI workforce lifecycle
steps: Create agent contract -> assign model/skill -> scoped data and actions -> evaluate scenarios -> owner activates -> mission assignments -> review metrics -> suspend/retire.
contracts: Agent not self-authorizing, avoid unsafe model degradation.

name: Notification and approval
steps: Event -> attention policy -> eligible recipients -> bundled notice -> inspect exact scope -> step-up where needed -> approve/deny -> mission update -> receipt.
contracts: Read != resolved, organization isolation, delivery receipts.

name: Monthly executive reporting
steps: Data freshness checks -> ledger/CRM/operations aggregation -> finance reconciliation -> AI insight drafting -> reviewer approval -> on-brand Docs/Present output -> authorized distribution.
contracts: No fabricated statistics, recipients, version and audit controls.

name: External client collaboration
steps: Project share grant -> portal invitation -> client authenticates -> accesses only scoped records -> comments/approves/pays -> native tasks and audit sync.
contracts: No cross-client leakage or arbitrary sharing inheritance.

name: Multi-entity organization
steps: Owner changes legal entity or brand -> UI scopes route, currency, locale and records -> AI context reset -> transactions remain within entity.
contracts: Cross-tenant and cross-entity access cannot be assumed.

name: Personal-device continuation
steps: Begin on desktop -> autosaved document/mission -> mobile authenticated session -> responsive state restores -> action approver confirms -> desktop reflects update.
contracts: Concurrent change detection, private device notifications.

name: Sensitive data deletion/export
steps: Authorized request -> retention/legal hold review -> scoped export or deletion jobs -> downstream connector requests -> verification -> evidence certificate.
contracts: Deletion cannot break legally required immutable audits.

name: Company emergency pause
steps: Authorized owner triggers pause -> execution dispatch prevented -> queued jobs checkpoint -> external side effects listed -> targeted revoke/escalation -> safe resume.
contracts: Cannot falsely claim that accepted third-party actions were reversed.
